hints.title: Dusk
hints.text: The bell has rung. The crew goes to their posts and the dead come, more every night. Press V to see which walls your guns cover, and keep a builder ready to repair (F).
hints.text_avatar: The bell has rung: the dead come. Hold the right button to aim, click to fire, R reloads. Climb a ladder to shoot over the wall. Click a crew card to radio them.
hints.text_avatar_always: The bell has rung: the dead come. Aim with the mouse, fire with the button, R reloads. Climb a ladder to shoot over the wall. Click a crew card to radio them.

hints.title: Running low
hints.text: Food or water is running low. Select someone, press G and send them scavenging: the houses have food and water. The stores panel shows the days left.
hints.text_avatar: Food or water is running low. Press G and send a party scavenging: the houses have food and water. The stores panel shows the days left.

hints.title: Ammo
hints.text: Ammo is running low. Select someone and press M to make more at the worktable from scrap, or send a trip to the hardware store (G).
hints.text_avatar: Ammo is running low. Give someone the Workbench job on the Duty roster (J) to make more from scrap, or send a trip to the hardware store (G).

hints.title: A wound
hints.text: Someone is bleeding. Ana bandages wounds on her own, and each bandage costs one medicine. A bite can also bring a fever: select them and press T.
hints.text_avatar: Someone is bleeding. Ana bandages wounds on her own, and each bandage costs one medicine. A bite can also bring a fever: click their card to see how they are.

hints.title: A fever
hints.text: Someone has a fever. Left alone it turns them into one of the dead. Select them and press T to treat it (two medicine), or X to send them out for good.
hints.text_avatar: Someone has a fever. Left alone it turns them into one of the dead. Answer the sick call on the radio card: treat (two medicine), keep apart or send out.

hints.title: A wall has fallen
hints.text: A wall piece is down and the dead can walk in. Select it and press F to rebuild it, and keep the crew at their posts.
hints.text_avatar: A wall piece is down and the dead can walk in. The Builders mend it; keep the crew at their posts and shoot what gets in.

hints.title: Runners
hints.text: Runners are fast and frail: they cross the yard in a few seconds. Keep the guns on the walls they come to, and press V to see where the guns reach.

hints.title: A brute
hints.text: A brute is slow and huge, and it tears walls down. The guns shoot it first. Keep a builder close to mend the wall it attacks (F).
hints.text_avatar: A brute is slow and huge, and it tears walls down. The guns shoot it first. Keep a builder close to mend the wall it attacks, and put your own rounds into it.

hints.title: The Town Board
hints.text: The pins are places on the road: a long trip means a night out. Scout to see more; clear a nest to quieten the nights.

hints.title: Winter
hints.text: Winter: the beds are frozen, the nights are long and the road takes longer. A greenhouse still gives food.

hints.title: Spring
hints.text: Spring: the thaw. The beds wake up and the rain barrels fill, but the nights are bigger than they were.

hints.title: Summer
hints.text: Summer: long days and short nights, and the water goes fast. The beds give the most and the roads are quick.

hints.title: The streets
hints.text: The streets round the school can be claimed on the Build screen (N): shut them with walls and the dead stay out of what you build there.

hints.title: A vehicle
hints.text: A vehicle makes the road about half the time and carries more. It burns fuel, found at the gas stations: take it from the Town Board's party.

hints.title: E uses what is there
hints.text: E, or a click, uses what is in reach: talk to someone, take a night post, work the bench, mend a worn wall, check a car. The prompt says what it will do.
hints.text_avatar_always: E uses what is at your feet: talk to someone, take a post on the wall, work the bench, mend a worn wall, check a car. The prompt says what it will do.

hints.title: The green ring
hints.text: The green ring round you: the crew inside it shoots better and faster. On a hard night stand where the dead come, and keep your people in the ring.

hints.title: Shut the gate
hints.text: Shut the gate at dusk: E at the gate lever. Its lamp is green while the gate is open and red while it is shut. An open gate in the dark lets the dead in.

hints.title: A Big Night is coming
hints.text: A Big Night needs you at the wall the forecast names, with plated brutes: shoot their heads. Be home before the dusk, and keep the crew inside your green ring.

hints.title: Leading a trip
hints.text: Pick a place, then Take control to lead the trip, or send them without you. On the road W A S D drives, and Tab hands the wheel to the autopilot: slower, but safe.

hints.title: Time to build
hints.text: The crew can build now. Press N and pick a building: a salvage bench pays for itself.
